name: Totsuzen Kaijin Ken Jimuin no Ore ga Mahou Shoujo-tachi o Otosu Hanashi ~Mahou Tenshi Angel Saber VS Aku no Soshiki Death Brand~
original_name: 突然怪人兼事務員の俺が魔法少女達を堕とす話 ～魔法天使エンジェルセイバーVS悪の組織デスブランド～
source:
There is an evil organization plotting to conquer the world: Death Brand.

And it's member, Tachikawa Masashi, has been fulfilling the duty of non-combatant grunt.

Until one day, when executive Ragulia transforms him into a monster. Why was that? There were the following reasons: cost reduction (lack of budget) and the makings of a monster. Masashi hated that, but he was threatened that if he refused, he would be fired and wouldn't be able to return to human form, and he was forcefully put to work. He was appointed to fight magical girls.

[i](This was a summary of the first title of the trilogy).[/i]

...Several months later.
Masashi has completely settled as a monster and a clerk at the same time. Usually he did office work, but, in the event of something happening, he worked as a (backup) monster. One day, he and Ragulia were called by the branch office chief and were announced that they were assigned to the new duty (with transfer): "to revive a branch in one provincial town".

...Nevertheless.
Two of them, who took up new posts, were at a loss for words from shock. That branch had many problems; it wasn't even operating. Equipment wasn't ready, combatants' skills were low, there weren't any monsters... These conditions were so extremely grave, so the "self-proclaimed" organization of justice, Justia, said that they would willfully destroy themselves and left them alone. At first, Masashi and Ragulia despaired, but in an attempt to some way or another recover the situation, they whipped their weakening hearts back into form and began to work constructively.

...And yet.
Justia sensed these movements, misunderstood something, and suddenly sent magical girls. Moreover, Death Brand's upper brass dispatched a female inspector in order to evaluate Ragulia. Masashi has to rectify just the worst situation ever, but in order to do it he ought to fight magical girls and even get involved in the organization's fractions and struggle with them.

Each one's thoughts are mixing. Each person's sense of values will soon be called into question. What is actually justice? What is evil?

...And so.
"I was sent here because, due to the state of the budget, a guy who can work as a monster and a clerk is only needed, wasn't I?... No, I've already given up on that, so let me work as normal."

Will Masashi be able to return to peace and quiet?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007570.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有一个邪恶组织密谋征服世界：死亡烙印。

而其成员立川雅志则一直履行着非战斗兵的职责。

直到有一天，主管拉古利亚把他变成了一个怪物。为什么会这样？原因如下：成本降低（缺乏预算）和怪物的气质。正史对此深恶痛绝，但他却被威胁说，如果他拒绝，他就会被解雇，而且无法变回人类，并被强行安排去工作。他被任命与魔法少女们战斗。[i]（这是三部曲第一部的总结）。[/i]……几个月后。
正志已经完全同时成为怪物和职员了。平时他做的是办公室工作，但一旦发生什么事情，他就会充当（后备）怪物。有一天，他和拉古利亚接到分公司负责人的电话，并被告知他们被分配到新的职责（带调动）：“在一个省城重振分公司”。

…尽管如此。
其中两个刚刚走上新岗位的人，震惊得说不出话来。那个分支有很多问题；它甚至没有运行。装备没有准备好，战斗者技能低下，没有怪物……这些条件实在是太严峻了，所以“自称”正义组织尤斯蒂亚说要肆意毁灭自己，放任不管。起初，正志和拉古利亚感到绝望，但为了试图以某种方式挽回局面，他们将衰弱的心重新振作起来，开始建设性地工作。

…然而。
尤斯蒂亚察觉到了这些动静，误会了什么，突然派出了魔法少女。而且，死亡烙印的高层还派了一名女督察来评估拉古利亚。正志必须纠正有史以来最糟糕的情况，但为了做到这一点，他必须与魔法少女战斗，甚至卷入组织的派别并与她们斗争。

每个人的心思都在混杂着。每个人的价值观很快就会受到质疑。什么才是真正的正义？什么是邪恶？

…所以。
“我之所以被派到这里，是因为预算状况，只需要一个能当怪物和职员的家伙不是吗？……不，我已经放弃了，所以让我像平常一样工作吧。”

正史能否重获平静呢？
